title: Israeli Airstrike Kills Nasman Family of Five in Gaza City's Al-Nasr Neighborhood
detail: An Israeli warplane struck a residential apartment building in Gaza City's Al-Nasr (Nassr) neighborhood without warning, killing Adham Ibrahim Sha'aban Nasman, his wife Marwa, and three of their children; a fourth child, Ayham, survived only because he was not home at the time and returned to find his family's bodies. The Israeli military said the strike targeted Nasman, describing him as chief of operations in Hamas's Gaza City Brigade and a commander involved in the October 7, 2023 attack; Hamas did not confirm any organizational affiliation, and the IDF did not publicly substantiate the claim or clarify the reasoning for striking a residential apartment. The strike came during a UN-documented surge in Gaza casualties, with the UN human rights office recording at least 57 Palestinians killed between July 13–20.

media.caption: Israeli strike on the Nasman family home in Gaza City's Al-Nasr neighborhood kills five — July 18, 2026
